component.name: PopUtil
component.summary: See every app on your PC and keep Pop!_OS tidy

description.p: PopUtil finds everything installed on your PC, wherever it came from: system packages, .deb files, Flatpaks, Snaps, AppImages, folders in /opt, install scripts, developer tools, game engines, Wine apps and games. It shows where each app lives, how it got there and how much space it takes, and removes the ones you don't need without breaking anything.

ul.li: Removals are simulated first, and anything Pop!_OS needs is protected
Removed apps wait in a holding area so you can restore them
One-click app installs, tweaks and maintenance
Disk cleanup and file organizing, with optional advice from Claude or Ollama

description.p: PopUtil manages your whole system, so it runs its engine outside the Flatpak sandbox.

screenshot.caption: Every app on the PC, grouped by where it lives
Where an app lives, how it got there, and a safe way to remove it

description.p: PopUtil is now a Flatpak with updates through the COSMIC Store, and has a new look.

ul.li: Fixed a crash when scanning Steam games you've never played
One unreadable place no longer stops the whole scan
Cleans up older PopUtil copies on first launch
Optional: match your COSMIC accent color

description.p: Apps on this PC: find, explain and safely remove apps from anywhere on the system.
